name: isRapid_modKernel
summary: Defined by cases on the exponent B: the decay bound of theta kernels of modular data, with the finite moment of a polynomial Fock vector.

steps.claim: The rapid decay is proved for each exponent B separately (one equation).
steps.lean:
| B => let ⟨_, _, _, c⟩ :=
      pairTheta_modDatum_decay S V a β h𝔪 hΨ B; ⟨_, (c _ h · (weightedNorm_polyVector_ne_top _ P))⟩

steps.claim: For an exponent B: by pairTheta_modDatum_decay (𝔪 has a place, Ψ is supported on left-invertible matrices) there are B', N and C with |θ(ω(g, h)(v ⊗ Ψ))|·ht(g)^B ≤ C·mom_N(v)·ht(h)^{B'} for all g, h and all v of finite N-th moment; for v = v_P the moment is finite (weightedNorm_polyVector_ne_top), so for the fixed h the right side is a constant bound.
steps.lean:
| B => let ⟨_, _, _, c⟩ :=
      pairTheta_modDatum_decay S V a β h𝔪 hΨ B; ⟨_, (c _ h · (weightedNorm_polyVector_ne_top _ P))⟩
